name: screen-mask
description: For screen sharing and recordings: hides API keys, tokens, private keys, e-mail addresses, IP addresses, your login name in paths and any names you list. Only the display changes; Claude still reads the original. Nothing leaves the machine. /mask switches it.

terms.title: Screen Mask: names and words to hide
terms.description: Comma separated, e.g. customer names, project code names, a server name. Case does not matter.

ips.title: Screen Mask: hide IP addresses
ips.description: IPv4 addresses except loopback and documentation ranges become [ip].

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the texts this mod shows and writes.
